hub.title: Selling
hub.subtitle: List an item, manage your stores and track your auctions.

stores.title: My stores
stores.emptyHint: Add a store to start selling. Every product belongs to one of your stores.
stores.deleteConfirm: Delete this store? This cannot be undone.

products.lockedInAuction: Locked while it is in an auction. Manage it from My auctions.
products.title: My products
products.emptyHint: Add a product first, then put it up for auction.
products.deleteConfirm: Delete this product? This cannot be undone.

auctions.title: My listings
auctions.emptyHint: Create a listing from one of your products.
auctions.submitHint: An admin reviews your listing before it goes live.
auctions.notEditable: Only drafts and rejected listings can be edited.
auctions.lockedWithBids: A live listing with bids can no longer be cancelled.
auctions.saleCancelled: The sale was cancelled; you can list it again.

fields.marketPriceHint: Shown on the listing as the original price. Optional.
fields.buyNowHint: Ends the auction immediately when paid. Optional.
fields.incrementLadder: Bids go up in steps set by Mazad: 1,000 IQD under 100,000; 5,000 up to 1 million; 25,000 up to 10 million; 100,000 above.
fields.oneLanguageHint: Arabic or English is enough; the other language shows the same text until you add it.

toast.auctionDraftSaved: Draft saved. Publish it when you are ready.
toast.auctionPublished: Published. Your auction is on Mazad.
toast.auctionSentForReview: Sent for review. It goes live once Mazad approves it.
